mainEntity.name: Do I need to remove my old countertops before installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, typically your old countertops need to be removed before the new ones can be installed. Our team handles the removal and disposal of your old countertops as part of our service, minimizing any hassle for you during the replacement process.
